steps.description: Locate the planner prompt definition file
steps.details: Identify the file where the planner prompt is defined. This is typically a configuration or script file within the AI orchestration pipeline.

steps.description: Open the planner prompt definition file
steps.details: Open the identified file in a text editor to make modifications to the planner prompt.

steps.description: Add rule for test command usage in planner prompt
steps.details: Within the planner prompt, add a rule that explicitly states: 'All test commands MUST use 'python -m pytest'. The use of 'pytest' alone is forbidden. If a command violates this rule, it must be regenerated until it complies.' Ensure this rule is clearly defined and integrated into the prompt's rule-based structure.

steps.description: Save changes to the planner prompt definition file
steps.details: After adding the new rule, save the changes to ensure the planner prompt is updated with the new requirements.

steps.description: Verify the planner prompt enforces the new rule
steps.details: Run the test suite associated with the planner prompt to verify that the new rule is enforced. Ensure that any test commands generated by the planner use 'python -m pytest' and that 'pytest' alone is not used.
